verdict.rationale: Stripe documents this use by name with a dedicated 'Issuing for agents' page: virtual cards that agents use to buy autonomously, with spend controls, real-time authorization decisioning, and cards scoped to a single task or session that are automatically invalidated after use. Spending controls cover merchant categories, merchant IDs, and per-authorization or monthly limits, and a synchronous webhook can approve or decline each authorization, which together give merchant locks and amount caps. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable expiry dates beyond single-use invalidation, an explicit allow-list (lock-to-merchant) control rather than block-lists, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
